craft_notes: Sthāyin: union-joy (power resting). Sanskrit first: locative absolute + union named → L4 sets condition line 1, goal line 2. Rows: row 1 (prize-last — upeya closes as prize closes). Rupture: colon after strong — resting stated, goal named. Close: end-weight on the prize. Minimal pass: colon for L3 comma. Read aloud: gripped, rests, prize. Rejected: 'energy' for śakti — killed: power kept (śakti-register); 'merges' — killed: rests kept (sthiti, not laya).

lines: Hold notions gripped, and power rests in the strong:
their oneness is the yogis' prize.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nigṛhīte svasaṃkalpe śakteḥ śaktimati sthitiḥ / śaktiśaktimator aikyam ity upeyaṃ ca yoginām

reads_against.argmap: Concepts restrained, power rests in the powerful; their oneness is the yogins' goal.
c1_essence: Concepts restrained: power rests in powerful; oneness the goal.
